newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila's PHIBOR rates higher in all maturities.
newsitem.headline: Manila's PHIBOR rates higher in all maturities.

text.p: Philippine interbank offered rates (PHIBOR) rose across the board on Tuesday, mirroring the tightness in the money market, traders said.

The Central Bank on Tuesday lifted its overnight lending rate to 15 from 13 percent due to the high demand for funds from banks correcting their weekend positions. Banks had to cover four days of reserve positions because Friday was a holiday.
Banks, therefore, adjusted upwards their swap rates at the PHIBOR market where banks could swap their dollars for the pesos they need, dealers said.
